policyNotes.intent: Owner decision 2026-09-02: keep live Protect master as it is. Do not tighten GitHub (thread resolution, strict/up-to-date, review-window, dossier-acceptance). Extra master-merge confirmation lives in agent rules.
policyNotes.approval: Native approval count stays at 0 while the repository has one human owner. Human authorization is SHA/base-bound through merge:ready, merge:execute and the extra master confirmation in pr-merge.mdc.
policyNotes.requiredChecks: This file lists the checks GitHub actually requires. Agent-grind names in config/agent-workflow.json#requiredChecks (review-window, dossier-acceptance) are not copied here and must not be treated as live ruleset drift.
policyNotes.deletion: deletion and non_fast_forward must remain present so master cannot be deleted or force-pushed.
policyNotes.squash: allowed_merge_methods must include squash because merge:execute uses squash. Other methods may remain.
policyNotes.mutation: This file and its checker are read-only against the live GitHub API. Do not edit the live ruleset to match an older stricter C1 picture.
